audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill / Yorick / Yorick / Skill / Skill / Yorick / Yorick — four stages to Yorick, none to Trundle — in the single best lane in this slice at 58.61% over 302 games. Six of the seven whys say Trundle wins that stage: "putting him immediately on the back foot", "the bite continues bleeding his Attack Damage", "your all-in is complete and his ghoul count is still sparse", "you out-trade him cleanly", "he cannot kill you in this power window", "turning every trade into the extended duel you win".
audit.why: A 58.61% lane with a chart that hands the enemy four stages is the widest gap between data and presentation on any page I audited. The kit agrees with the paragraphs: Yorick's swarm is built from graves, graves come from Last Rites hitting a champion or from units dying, and none of that exists in the first three levels.
audit.corrected: Trundle from level 1 through first item; two-plus items stays Yorick, where whys[6] correctly gives him the Maiden.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] and whys[6] build the late game entirely on the Maiden with no cooldown attached, and spikes[1] describes the level-6 spike as Yorick "handing you free resistance stacks" because he "builds bruiser HP and tenacity".
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 seconds — the longest cooldown in the matchup and 40 seconds longer than Subjugate at rank 1. That reframes the whole late game: the Maiden is a periodic problem on a very slow timer, not a permanent state, and killing her early costs him minutes rather than seconds. Tenacity has nothing to do with what Subjugate takes; the ultimate takes 40% of armour and MR plus a fifth of his maximum health as damage, healing Trundle the same.
audit.corrected: Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s against Subjugate's 120/100/80. Kill the Maiden and the window is minutes long.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is named in eleven fields across both layers as a cage to be avoided, and not one of them says the wall can be broken.
audit.why: Riot's own text calls it a DESTRUCTIBLE wall. Trundle inside the ring is not trapped — he is one segment away from walking out, and with Frozen Domain's attack speed under his feet he breaks it faster than almost anyone. Every field on the page instead says "don't get caged" and "engage only on its downtime", which turns a solvable problem into a reason to refuse the fight in a lane Trundle wins 58.61% of the time.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession is destructible — attack the nearest segment and walk out rather than waiting the ring out.

audit.whatIsWrong: `early` says "his E (Mourning Mist) summons ghouls only after he has built them", and the ghoul economy is described everywhere as running purely off minion deaths.
audit.why: Mourning Mist summons nothing. Riot's text: it throws a globule that REDUCES ARMOUR, damages, slows and marks, and Yorick's summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets. The armour reduction is the part that matters most here and appears nowhere on the page — it is aimed directly at the resistances Subjugate just moved onto you, which is the real reason to cast R before he lands the mark rather than after. Graves also come from Last Rites, which digs one whenever it hits a champion, not only when minions die.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist (12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range): armour shred, slow and a mark that speeds his Walkers toward you. Last Rites digs graves off champions too.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] says Chomp slows Yorick's attack speed. Last Rites is never named as an auto-attack reset or as a heal.
audit.why: Chomp saps Attack Damage and slows movement. Last Rites is a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4-second empowered attack that heals him and resets his attack timer — _missing-interactions.json raises both needs-antiheal and autoreset-burst-tell for this matchup. The reset is the tell: his damage arrives on a wind-up, not on a cast bar, so the bite you want is the one that lands before it.
audit.corrected: Chomp: AD sap, movement slow. Last Rites: auto-reset, heals him, 6s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The only cooldown figure on the page is wrong: `mid` says "Keep a mental clock on the cage cooldown (30 seconds) and engage only on its downtime".
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12 seconds. Thirty is not any rank of it. A player waiting ten extra seconds for a cage that is already back is a player who walks into it, and the entire levels 4-5 plan is built on that timer. The rest: Mourning Mist 12/11/10/9/8s, Last Rites 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s, against Chomp's flat 3.5s and Pillar of Ice's 21s — which is almost exactly the cage's own rank-1 cooldown, so the two trade one for one early.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession 20/18/16/14/12s, not 30. Pillar of Ice at 21s trades with it almost exactly at rank 1.

audit.why: report[8] buys Executioner's Calling on the first back, which is right — Last Rites heals him on a 6-second cooldown and _missing-interactions.json flags needs-antiheal. Plated Steelcaps against a physical kit and a physical swarm is also right. Left alone.

The packet's suspectName "Use Pillar of Ice (E)" in wants.you[2] is a false positive on the name. One kit-library note I did not propagate: Mourning Mist carries a dash flag, which contradicts Riot's description of a thrown globule of Black Mist.

edits.before: At level 1 hit Chomp immediately on every auto trade — you are already stealing his Attack Damage and healing off the minion wave through King's Tribute before he has a single ghoul. Yorick's graves require minion deaths to stack and his E (Mourning Mist) summons ghouls only after he has built them, so the first two minutes are the leanest his kit will ever be. Push him off the wave if he tries to last-hit at close range and make him spend graves inefficiently. By level 3 you have Q+W+E and he might have two or three ghouls at best — drop Frozen Domain, Chomp his AD down, and walk him into your Pillar if he tries to back away. He cannot out-trade your sustained bite-and-heal loop at this stage.
edits.after: At level 1 hit Chomp on every auto trade — you are already sapping his Attack Damage and healing off the wave through King's Tribute before he has a single Mist Walker. Graves come from Last Rites, which digs one whenever it hits a champion or whenever the target dies, so denying him last-hits denies him the swarm. Mourning Mist is the other half: it marks you, shreds your armour, and sends the Walkers he already has sprinting at the mark. Push him off the wave if he last-hits at close range. By level 3 you have Q+W+E and he has two or three ghouls at best — drop Frozen Domain, Chomp his AD down, and walk him into your Pillar of Ice.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 respect one thing: his W cage (Dark Procession). If Yorick surrounds you with the wall while a ghoul cluster and early Maiden strikes are active, the multi-source damage can overwhelm even your W healing. Keep a mental clock on the cage cooldown (30 seconds) and engage only on its downtime — the rest of the trade you win cleanly by staying in Frozen Domain and re-applying Chomp every few seconds to keep his AD suppressed. At level 6 activate Subjugate immediately when you go for the all-in: Yorick's early bruiser build means you are literally borrowing his own defenses mid-fight, and the resistance drain combined with Frozen Domain healing makes you nearly unkillable in this window. If he tries to summon the Maiden during your all-in, use Pillar to disrupt his positioning and keep him locked in your domain.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 5 respect one thing: Dark Procession. If Yorick rings you with the wall while a ghoul cluster is active, the multi-source damage can overwhelm even your W healing — but the wall is destructible, so the answer is to break the nearest segment rather than to wait inside it. Keep a clock on the cage: 20 seconds at rank 1 falling to 12, almost exactly your own Pillar of Ice. The rest of the trade you win cleanly by staying in Frozen Domain and re-applying Chomp every 3.5 seconds to keep his AD suppressed. At level 6 open the all-in with Subjugate: 40% of his armour and MR plus a fifth of his max health, healing you the same. Cast it before Mourning Mist lands, because that mark shreds the armour straight back off you again. If he summons the Maiden mid-fight, spend Pillar of Ice to keep him inside your domain.

edits.before: Past two items Yorick becomes a legitimate threat because the Maiden runs independently and his ghoul output reaches its ceiling — the cage plus a full swarm plus Maiden strikes is a lot of simultaneous damage that can outpace your healing even with Subjugate active. Your job is to convert the early lane lead into objectives and a gold advantage large enough that you can still kill him in a direct duel, then immediately track and kill the Maiden before it reaches your base. If you let him splitpush freely with the Maiden auto-attacking structures while you are occupied elsewhere, the map becomes his. Win the game before it reaches that state.
edits.after: Past two items Yorick becomes a legitimate threat: the Maiden runs independently, his ghoul output reaches its ceiling, and Mourning Mist is shredding the armour Subjugate just handed you. Your job is to convert the early lane lead into objectives and a gold advantage large enough to still kill him in a direct duel, then track and kill the Maiden before it reaches your base. Eulogy of the Isles is 160 seconds at rank 1 and 100 at rank 3, so a Maiden you kill early costs him minutes, not seconds. If you let him splitpush freely while the Maiden chews on structures elsewhere, the map becomes his — win the game before it reaches that state.

notes: Two findings dominate this page. First, Dark Procession is a DESTRUCTIBLE wall in Riot's own text, and eleven fields across both layers treat it as an inescapable cage — a Trundle standing on Frozen Domain's attack speed breaks a segment faster than almost anyone in the game, so the page's central instruction (refuse the fight until the cage is down) is backwards in a lane he wins 58.61% of the time. Second, `mid` gives the cage a 30-second cooldown; it is 20/18/16/14/12, so the one number on the page is not any rank of the ability. Also corrected: `early` claims Mourning Mist summons ghouls — it marks, slows and shreds armour, and that armour shred is aimed squarely at what Subjugate just gave you, which is a real cast-order rule the page never states. Chart was Yorick 4/7 over Trundle's best win rate in the slice.
